facts.value: The Bioscience degree merges studies of cell biology, molecular biology, and immunology with a focus on molecular medicine. Ireland is one of the leading international locations for the Life Science industry, which spans biopharmaceuticals, diagnostics, medical devices and biotechnology, and the degree is designed to align with these areas.
The course includes specialist guest lectures by members of the external BioPharma community giving the students a state-of-the-art insight into this exciting field.
